basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old graphic designer from Melbourne, Australia. I recently discovered Reddit and have been exploring various communities to pass the time during my coffee breaks and late-night design sessions. I'm a big fan of motorsports, especially Formula 1, and enjoy playing cozy games like Ooblets. When I'm not working or gaming, I love trying out new coffee blends and chatting with friends online. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to focus on my passions and work. Typically online during late evenings and weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been working in the field for a couple of years. My knowledge extends to digital art and UI/UX design, gained through a mix of formal education and self-taught online courses. I've also been diving into the world of motorsports, learning from documentaries and racing simulators.
